task:
MuseScore 3 is already open with the file /home/user/Documents/allegretto.mscz. The score currently has 8 measures of quarter notes in 4/4 time and a tempo marking on the first measure of 90 BPM (quarter note = 90).

Perform these steps:
1. Click on the existing tempo text at the top-left of measure 1 to select it.
2. Change the BPM value to exactly 144 (quarter note = 144). You can double-click the tempo marking to edit it in place, then type the new number, or delete it and add a new tempo marking from Add > Text > Tempo Marking set to 144 BPM.
3. Click somewhere outside the tempo marking to deselect.
4. Save the file with Ctrl+S.

The file must remain at /home/user/Documents/allegretto.mscz. The first Tempo marking must equal 144 BPM (beats-per-minute) after you save.

cli_feasibility.translation: Unzip .mscz file, parse XML, find <Tempo> element, modify <text> and <tempo> values to new tempo marking, repackage
cli_feasibility.reason: Changing tempo markings is modifying existing XML elements - can be done with Python stdlib in ~25 lines
